title: This Chimp Was Shocked 76 Times for Being Right

scenes.voiceover: This chimpanzee was shocked seventy six times in orbit for giving the correct answers. And he kept giving them anyway.
scenes.visualConcept: Enos the chimp, real photo, punch in.

scenes.voiceover: November 1961. Enos became the only chimp ever to orbit the Earth. He had been trained to pull levers when a light flashed, to prove an astronaut could still work up there.
scenes.mainText: THE ONLY CHIMP TO ORBIT EARTH

scenes.voiceover: Then a wire crossed. His panel reversed. Now every time Enos pulled the correct lever, the machine punished him with an electric shock instead of a reward.
Seventy six times, he was shocked for being right. And seventy six times, Enos kept pulling the correct lever anyway. He orbited twice and came home alive.
scenes.mainText: 76 SHOCKS. HE NEVER GAVE A WRONG ANSWER.

scenes.voiceover: Enos was one of many animals who did our most dangerous work first. Every one of them is on the channel.
scenes.mainText: EVERY ANIMAL WE SENT UP → ON THE CHANNEL
